trap.label: nominalização formal
trap.wrong: Because they communicated poorly, the failure of the project.
trap.right: Poor communication led to the failure of the project.
trap.why: O português mantém verbos e advérbios. Em inglês acadêmico, nominalize (communicate → communication) e use um verbo como led to.

opts: The adoption of the plan helped.
The adopt of the plan helped.

fix.wrong: The adopt of the plan helped.
fix.right: The adoption of the plan helped.

rewrite.prompt: Nominalize: “They adopted the plan, and it helped.” (The … of the plan helped.)
rewrite.answer: The adoption of the plan helped.

rewrite.prompt: Particípio: “After we had tried several times, we stopped.”
rewrite.answer: Having tried several times, we stopped.

rewrite.prompt: Nominalize: “Because they communicated poorly, the project failed.” (Poor … led to the failure of the project.)
rewrite.answer: Poor communication led to the failure of the project.
